caption: The drawing depicts a red metal coffee pot with a lid, a curved handle attached to the side, and a spout extending diagonally from the body. The pot's conical body and lid feature decorative floral patterns in shades of yellow, black, white, and pink, with symmetric and curved petal-like shapes. The red surface has areas where the paint appears chipped or worn, revealing patches of a darker underlying color. The background is plain and light, providing contrast to the brightly colored coffee pot.
title: Coffeepot
